detail.title: Nonreciprocal Coupling and Coarse-Grained Dissipation Bounds
detail.summary: Recent findings extend dissipation bounds by incorporating information-rate constraints from quantum channels with memory, suggesting that entropy production is bounded not just by thermodynamic variables, but by the input ensemble's separable-state capacity.
detail.reason: Revising the notebook to integrate new evidence regarding memory-constrained channels and thermodynamic uncertainty relations.
